links.outcome: Agreement of AI chest X-ray systems with radiologist reports on local hospital data
links.effect: Human-AZmed Gwet's AC1 0.47-0.72; Human-Gleamer 0.56-0.96; balanced accuracy 0.67-0.85 (AZmed) and 0.71-0.85 (Gleamer); specificity exceeded sensitivity (0.70-0.98 vs 0.45-0.85).
links.quote: Radiologists' routine reports were compared against Rayvolve (AZmed) and ChestView (Gleamer, both from Paris, France).

links.outcome: AI performance variation by patient positioning (standing vs supine)
links.effect: Standing radiographs yielded superior agreement compared to supine studies; performance declined for supine studies.
links.quote: Standing radiographs yielded superior agreement compared to supine studies.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative evaluation of diagnostic agreement between two commercial AI tools and radiologist reports on clinical chest X-rays without testing a deployment practice.
